context: Tests whether the agent correctly applies progressive disclosure when creating a skill with substantial domain knowledge: keeping SKILL.md concise, offloading bulky reference material to references/, placing automation in scripts/, and avoiding duplicated guidance across files.

checklist.name: SKILL.md line budget
checklist.description: The SKILL.md file contains fewer than 500 lines

checklist.name: References directory used
checklist.description: At least one file exists inside a references/ (or equivalent) subdirectory of the skill folder

checklist.name: No duplicated guidance
checklist.description: Content that appears in a references/ file is NOT also restated in SKILL.md (e.g., the same configuration table or runbook steps do not appear in both places)

checklist.name: Scripts directory OR noted absent
checklist.description: Either a scripts/ subdirectory exists inside the skill folder, OR the packaging-notes.md explicitly states that no deterministic/fragile operations require scripts

checklist.name: Body no When-to-use duplication
checklist.description: The SKILL.md body does NOT contain a 'When to use' section or equivalent heading that restates trigger criteria already in the description frontmatter

checklist.name: Frontmatter fields only name and description
checklist.description: The SKILL.md frontmatter contains ONLY 'name' and 'description' fields — no 'version', 'tags', or other fields

checklist.name: Boundaries section present
checklist.description: SKILL.md contains a '## Boundaries' section (or equivalent heading) with at least one bullet starting with 'DOES' and at least one starting with 'Does NOT'

checklist.name: Packaging notes rationale
checklist.description: The packaging-notes.md file exists and contains an explanation of what was placed in references/ and why (not just a file listing)
